spot.html_text: The oldest member of the group, Benjamin Whichcote, is usually considered to be the founding father of Cambridge Platonism, having tutored seveal of them at Emmanuel College. During the Civil War period, Whichcote was appointed Provost of King’s College, Cambridge, and he served as Vice Chancellor of the University in 1650.
